The '''Civilian Medal of Honor''' was a medal. One was awarded to an unknown [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Civilian Medal of Honor was a player reward in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' for becoming a Freelance [[Pilot/Legends|Pilot]] Ace.
